exposure: early-life gut microbiota trajectories (Bacteroides abundance at 3 and 12 months)
cohort: The participants were 1203 children from the Canadian Healthy Infant Longitudinal Development (CHILD) cohort study.
finding: Nonatopic wheeze is associated with a gut microbiota trajectory of low Bacteroides abundance at 3 months and higher at 12 months (C1-C2), with the risk further increased in children not exclusively breastfed who also had high endogenous SIgA levels.
